main_text.p: potest, & corruptelas impedire aut corri-gere §[?] quæ civili animadversione dignæ p.817. Etth.52. p.819. dicunt Magistratum tanquam quarti præcepti custodem procurare debere, ut viri idonei pcr presbyterium accedente tùm INPRIMIS ipsius, tùm totius quoque Ecclesiæ consensu ac suffragio ad munus pastorale legitimè vocentur, ac coram Ecclesia ordinentur ex more Apo-stolorum & Euangelistarum. Act.14.23. Tit 1.5. quem patres nostri sub piis vi-ventes Magistratibus constanter ob-servarunt. Summa: cura, ut omnia rectè fiant, in vocatione seu Electione pastorum pertinet ad Magistratum, ait rectissimè Amesius Cas. conscientiæ p.265. Cum hac curâ & potestate Magistratus circa Electionem, conjuncta est etiam potestas illius circa ordinationem pastorum. Constat Magistratus po-testatem non versari circa eam for-maliter; versatur tamen circa eam objectivè. Nam ut rectè idem vir Clarissimus ibidem ait: Ordinationem

page.notes: The line "gere §[?] quæ" has a symbol before "quæ" that I could not identify; it may be a printed abbreviation or a damaged ligature. "pcr" is printed as shown (for per). "Etth.52" may be a misprint or abbreviation and is copied as printed. The italic stretches are read from the scan and may not be exact at their edges. The reference lines are kept in the running text, since they sit in the column. The text is set as one continuous paragraph because no clear indent marks a new paragraph on this page.
